run_openai_tool_calling_client: run the vLLM OpenAI client to perform chat completion with tool calling using a local server
handle_tool_calls_stream: stream chat completion tool calls from a vLLM server using the OpenAI Python client
handle_tool_calls_arguments: parse streamed tool call chunks and extract function arguments from the vLLM response
get_current_weather: simulate a weather lookup tool that returns temperature and conditions for a given city and state
main: run the full tool calling flow with non-streamed completion, streaming, tool execution, and a follow-up completion
